The best-scoring candidate I found is the 16-column linear fit in t⁰ and t²·{1, A, 1/A, 1/A², ln A/A, ln A}, which gave 6e-9 with the A-basis above. That fit is not a clean closed form, so the t⁰ part of the law is still unresolved.
